# Aadesh Salecha: full profile

> Plain-text version of https://aadeshsalecha.github.io/ for AI agents and other automated readers. Last updated 2026-11-18. Short index: https://aadeshsalecha.github.io/llms.txt

## Summary

Aadesh Salecha is a Founding Engineer at Hyfin in San Francisco, building AI for clean energy finance. He works on applied AI for climate, energy finance and planetary intelligence. He holds an MS in Computer Science from Stanford University (2026) and a BS in Computer Science, summa cum laude, from the University of Minnesota (2021). Before Hyfin he was an AI/ML Engineer at Amazon (AWS SageMaker HyperPod) and a Senior Software Engineer at DraftKings. His research spans geospatial machine learning for carbon sequestration and the evaluation of human-like biases in large language models.

- Name: Aadesh Salecha
- Current role: Founding Engineer, Hyfin (https://www.hyfin.capital/), San Francisco, CA, since March 2026
- Education: MS Computer Science, Stanford University (Sep 2024 – May 2026); BS Computer Science, University of Minnesota (Aug 2018 – May 2021), GPA 4.0, summa cum laude
- Email: aadeshsalecha@gmail.com
- Website: https://aadeshsalecha.github.io/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aadesh-salecha

- Stanford Profiles: https://profiles.stanford.edu/aadesh-salecha

## Research interests

- Applied AI for climate and energy: geospatial ML, remote sensing, satellite imagery (Google Earth Engine, Landsat, Sentinel-2, AlphaEarth embeddings)
- Generative AI: LLM evaluation, preference tuning, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), application building
- Applied NLP for psychology and the social sciences

## Experience

### Hyfin: Founding Engineer (March 2026 – present, San Francisco, CA)
- Building GAIA, a fintech platform that synthesizes asset performance and market data for clean energy loan origination.
- Designed agentic data enrichment pipelines that combine LLMs and web scraping to create data for a new asset class with no track record.
- Architecting risk intelligence tools aimed at the $4T+ clean energy financing gap across South Asia and Africa.
- Leads the rollout of AI-native workflows and processes across the team.

### Amazon (AWS SageMaker HyperPod): AI/ML Engineer (May 2025 – September 2025, Seattle, WA)
- Designed an agentic AI system combining telemetry, time-series signals and RAG-based diagnosis to auto-resolve ML infrastructure failures.
- Reduced GPU energy waste, lowering the operational carbon footprint by about 200 kg CO2e per day through efficiency modeling and anomaly detection.
- Optimized distributed compute scheduling using ML-based pattern detection.

### Stanford University: AI/ML Researcher (May 2023 – May 2026, Palo Alto, CA)
- With Prof. David Lobell and the Center on Food Security and the Environment (Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability): built geospatial ML pipelines on Google Earth Engine, Landsat and Sentinel-2 imagery to detect tree species across cropland in the Global South, supporting verification of the 5+ Gt CO2/year sequestration potential of integrating trees into global cropland.
- With Prof. Johannes Eichstaedt (Stanford HAI-affiliated): applied cognitive science and psychometrics to evaluate LLMs; showed that LLMs exhibit human-like social desirability biases (PNAS Nexus, covered by WIRED).
- Won Stanford's first Green AI Hackathon with a geothermal site prediction system built on AlphaEarth satellite embeddings (93% AUC): https://findgeothermal.com/

### DraftKings: Senior Software Engineer, Financial Platform (December 2021 – June 2024, Boston, MA)
- Developed a sharded database storing millions of user transactions, with support for cryptocurrencies.
- Built REST APIs handling billions of requests with under 200 ms latency.
- Led cross-functional work with product managers that reduced user dropout by 40%.
